preconditions.description: The number of boxes n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The index x of the box that got the last ball must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each box must contain between 0 and 1,000,000,000 balls.
The box at index x must have at least one ball.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers representing the initial number of balls in each box.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must represent a valid number of balls in a box.

postconditions.expression: any(b_i != a_i for b_i, a_i in zip(map(int, stdout.split()), a))
postconditions.description: The output must represent a different arrangement of balls from the final state.
